title.en: Bound to, likely to, chances are

es: Reconocer y graduar la probabilidad con bound to, likely to, chances are, there is a good chance y may well.

teaching.en: Our team is bound to win on Saturday because it has not lost a match this year.
teaching.es: Nuestro equipo seguro que gana el sábado porque no ha perdido ningún partido este año.
teaching.explanationEs: Be bound to + verbo base: casi seguro. No es una obligación, es certeza.
segments: Our team is bound to win on Saturday because
it has not lost a match this year.
teaching.audioText: Our team is bound to win on Saturday because it has not lost a match this year.

teaching.en: Leo is likely to score, because he is the best player in the team.
teaching.es: Es probable que Leo marque, porque es el mejor jugador del equipo.
teaching.explanationEs: Be likely to + verbo base: probable, más posible que no.
segments: Leo is likely to score, because he
is the best player in the team.
teaching.audioText: Leo is likely to score, because he is the best player in the team.

teaching.en: Chances are that the match will start late because of the rain.
teaching.es: Lo más probable es que el partido empiece tarde por la lluvia.
teaching.explanationEs: Chances are (that) + frase completa con sujeto y verbo.
segments: Chances are that the match will
start late because of the rain.
teaching.audioText: Chances are that the match will start late because of the rain.

teaching.en: There is a good chance that Sara will play on Saturday.
teaching.es: Hay buenas posibilidades de que Sara juegue el sábado.
teaching.explanationEs: There is a good chance (that) + frase: buena posibilidad, sin asegurarla.
segments: There is a good chance that
teaching.audioText: There is a good chance that Sara will play on Saturday.

teaching.en: The other team may well be stronger, so nobody can be sure.
teaching.es: Bien puede que el otro equipo sea más fuerte, así que nadie puede estar seguro.
teaching.explanationEs: May well + verbo base: es bastante posible; sube la fuerza de may.
segments: The other team may well be
stronger, so nobody can be sure.
teaching.audioText: The other team may well be stronger, so nobody can be sure.

teaching.en: Tom is unlikely to play because he hurt his leg last week.
teaching.es: Es improbable que Tom juegue porque se lesionó la pierna la semana pasada.
teaching.explanationEs: Be unlikely to + verbo base: poco probable.
segments: Tom is unlikely to play because
he hurt his leg last week.
teaching.audioText: Tom is unlikely to play because he hurt his leg last week.

prompt.es: Según el texto, ¿qué se dice de Hill?

choices.text: Hill is likely to finish second.
Hill is bound to finish second.
Hill is unlikely to finish second.

feedback.es: El texto dice que Hill «is only likely to finish second»: es probable, pero no seguro. Bound to sería certeza.

hint.es: Busca la expresión que lleva only: es probable, no casi seguro.

origin.text: Two teams, two predictions. Riverside has won every match this year, so it is bound to win on Saturday. Hill has a new coach, so it is only likely to finish second.

prompt.es: Completa: «Mia se lesionó la pierna, así que es improbable que juegue el sábado.»

feedback.es: Una lesión hace poco probable que Mia juegue: se usa unlikely, el opuesto de likely.

hint.es: La lesión hace que jugar sea poco probable, no probable.

origin.text: Mia hurt her leg, so she is ___ to play on Saturday.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Lo más probable es que el partido empiece tarde.»

answer.text: Chances are that the match will start late

feedback.es: La expresión fija Chances are that abre la frase y después va una oración completa con will.

hint.es: Empieza con la expresión fija que significa «lo más probable es que».

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué piensa quien habla sobre Sara.

feedback.es: «A good chance» indica buena posibilidad, es decir, probable. «Certainly» sería bound to, y no se dice que no juegue.

origin.audio: Sara is our best player, so there is a good chance that she will score on Saturday.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada predicción con su traducción.

pairs: Leo is bound to win the race.

pairs.es: Leo seguro que gana la carrera.

pairs: Leo is likely to win the race.

pairs.es: Es probable que Leo gane la carrera.

pairs: Leo may well win the race.

pairs.es: Bien puede que Leo gane la carrera.

pairs: Leo is unlikely to win the race.

pairs.es: Es improbable que Leo gane la carrera.

feedback.es: Cada expresión gradúa la predicción: bound to es casi seguro, likely to es probable, may well es bastante posible y unlikely to es poco probable.

prompt.es: Completa: «Lo más probable es que el autobús llegue tarde por el tráfico.»

feedback.es: Chances are that + frase completa es la expresión fija para «lo más probable es que».

origin.text: ___ are that the bus will be late because of the traffic.

choices.text: It will rain in the morning.
It will be dry in the afternoon.

feedback.es: El texto dice que «snow is unlikely»: que nieve es improbable. La lluvia por la mañana y la tarde seca son probables.

origin.text: Forecast for Friday's school trip: there is a good chance that it will rain in the morning. The afternoon is likely to be dry, and snow is unlikely.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Es improbable que el equipo gane sin Leo.»

answer.text: The team is unlikely to win without Leo
accepted: The team is unlikely to win without Leo
Without Leo the team is unlikely to win

feedback.es: Be unlikely to + verbo base expresa poca probabilidad; without Leo cierra la frase.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué piensa el conductor sobre el autobús.

choices.text: The bus will almost certainly arrive late.
The bus will probably arrive on time.

feedback.es: «Bound to be late» significa casi seguro que llega tarde. «Probably on time» y «early» contradicen el audio.

origin.audio: The road is closed, so the bus is bound to be late.

prompt.es: Completa: «Hay buenas posibilidades de que la tienda abra el domingo.»

feedback.es: There is a good chance that + frase expresa buena posibilidad; chance es el sustantivo de la expresión.

origin.text: There is a good ___ that the shop will be open on Sunday.

prompt.es: Escribe la predicción sobre Ana y el concurso.

answer.text: Ana is bound to win the drawing contest.
accepted: Ana is bound to win the drawing contest.
Ana is bound to win the contest.

feedback.es: Para algo casi seguro se usa is bound to + verbo base, aquí win, seguido del concurso.

origin.text: Predicción: Ana seguro que gana (win). Concurso de dibujo: drawing contest.

prompt.es: Según Mia, ¿qué frase describe mejor su asistencia a la fiesta?

choices.text: Mia is bound to come to the party.
Mia is unlikely to come to the party.
Mia is likely to dance all night.

feedback.es: Mia dice que está muy cansada y resfriada: lo lógico es que sea improbable que vaya a la fiesta.

origin.text: Mia says: «I am very tired, and I have a bad cold.»

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué piensan del tren.

choices.text: They are sure the bus will be late.
They think the train is unlikely to be late.
They think the train will probably be late.

feedback.es: «Chances are that» indica probabilidad: piensan que el tren llegará tarde y por eso toman el autobús.

origin.audio: Chances are that the train will be late, so let's take the bus.
